referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the shredding of the used glider of a scooter, without battery and drivetrain. The entries are given per kg glider. The original data has been collected for a glider of about 80 kg. Data is based on the e-waste shredding dataset which is based on literature. Infrastructure assumptions for the treatment facility are, too, based on assumptions taken from e-waste treatments. The output scrap and waste material quantities are derived from the respective glider dataset. The materialization of the glider is divided in 5 main fractions: scrap steel, scrap Aluminium, scrap Copper, scrap plastics and a shredding residue. These are the output waste flows of the process.The details concerning the materialization of the glider treated in this dataset are described in the dataset described by Leuenberger in "Life cycle assessment of two wheel vehicle" .; UUID: 9c9194be-10e2-34b2-a77b-d8a8e5a5d8df
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset takes as input the used glider and includes the treatment facility. This dataset returns the scrap fractions going to the specific recycling facilities and the emissions produced during the treatment process.
referenceFunction.name: Disposal, glider, for electric scooter

geography.text: Data from a European study, values used as global average data.

technology.text: Modern Shredder facility with 2 shredder, 2 magnetic separation & 2 Eddy-current separation steps.
